main_text.p: ϰαὶ σῶμα τῶ, πάντων τ κακῶν ὑπ τέ-πατων, πάντων τ ἀγαθῶν πηίξιν, ἁμαρτίας ἀναίρεσις, φυτὸν ἀναστάσεως, ξύλον ζωῆς αἰωνίς: Clypeus & armatura & tropæum contra diabolum, signaculum ne tangat nos everfor, jacentium erectio, stantium fulcrum, infirmorum scipio, pastorum virga, revertentium manuductio, proficientium perfectio, anima conservatio & corporis, omnium malorum aversio, omnium bonorum conciliatio, peccati pernicies, stirps resurrectionis, lignum vitæ æterna. Da hanc nobis ô ÆTERNE.
main_text.head: FINIS LIBRI III.
DE CRVCE.

page.notes: The Greek line is printed in Greek type and is transcribed as legible; several Greek words are doubtful and may contain errors. The "JVSTI" line at the foot is a signature-like catchword, placed as printed.
